spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Which, (of many.)
E.
यट् which, and अकच् aff.

m. (-कृत्)
The liver.
E.
य union, (of the parts of the body,) कृ to make, aff. क्विप् and तुक्.

f. (-का)
A cockroach.
E.
यकृत् the liver, and आत्मन self, कन् aff., fem. form; like it in colour.

f. (-री)
A plant, a sort of tree, (Andersonia rohitaka.)
E.
यकृत् liver, and वैर inimical to.

r. 10th cl. (यक्षयते)
To worship, to honour or adore.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A demigod, attendant especially on KUVERA, and employed in the care of his gardens and treasures.
2 A name of

KUVERA.
3

The residence of INDRA.
f. (-क्षी)
The wife of KUVERA.
E.
यक्ष to worship, aff. घञ्.

m. (-मः)
Perfumed paste, used especially for anointing the body, and consisting of camphor, agallochum, musk and Kakkola; or the three first, with saffron and Sandal in equal proportions.
E.
यक्ष the demigod, and कर्द्दम clay; a perfume of which these beings are supposed to be fond.

m. (-पः)
1 Resin in general.
2 Turpentine, the resinous exudation of the pine.
E.
यक्ष the demigod, and धूप perfume or incense, अण् aff.

m. (-सः)
Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
यक्ष the demigod, and रस taste, fondness.

m. (-राट्)
KUVERA, the deity of wealth, and lord of the demigods called Yakṣas.
2 A palæstrum, a place prepared for wrestling or boxing.
E.
यक्ष a Yakṣa, and राज् who rules or shines.

m. (-जः)
KUVERA: see the last.
E.
यक्ष the demigod, so called, and राज sovereign.

f. (-री)
Alakā the capital of KUVERA, supposed to be seated on mount Kailāsa.
E.
यक्ष्राज KUVERA, and पुरी city.

f. (-त्रिः)
The night of the day of full moon in the month Kārttika: see दीपाली.
E.
यक्ष the demigod, and रात्रि night; these spirits being supposed to be then abroad.

m. (-कः)
A tree, described as a sort of date.
E.
यक्ष a Yakṣa, and आमलक myrobalan.

m. (-सः)
The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.)
E.
यक्ष demigod, and आवास abode.

f. (-णी)
1 The wife of

KUVERA.
2

The wife of a Yakṣa.
3 A sort of female fiend, attached to the service of DURGĀ, and frequently maintaining, like a sylph or fairy, an intercourse with mortals.
E.
यक्षिन् a name of KUVERA, and ङीष् aff.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A name of KUVERA.
E.
यक्ष, and इन्द्र lord.

m. (-शः)
KUVERA.
E.
यक्ष, and ईश lord; also यक्षेश्वर and the like.

n. (-कं)
The fruit of the Ficus religiosa.

f. (-घ्नी)
The raisin, or dried grape.
E.
यक्ष्म consumption, and घ्न destroyer.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
Pulmonary consumption.
E.
यक्ष to worship, and मनिन् Uṇādi aff.; also with मन् aff. यक्ष्म m. (-क्ष्मः)

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Proposing or wishing to worship.
E.
यक्ष to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.
